Core Recommendation: Relocate Note to research/ & Adjust Links
While the formatting, style, and content of your research note are excellent and highly professional, there is a conceptual structural mismatch in its directory placement.

Because this document is a reusable design reference (type: research-note) rather than a step-by-step developer tutorial or operational runbook, it should live under the root-level research/ bundle rather than nested inside the operational docs/recipes/memory_extractor/ sub-bundle.

Section 1 — Analysis of Directory Mismatch
The repository enforces a clean separation of concerns between recipes/runbooks and reusable research/design references:

docs/recipes/ sub-bundles are reserved for operational, executable guides (e.g., how to run a calibration run, how to set up GCP). They are structured sequentially and typically carry type: runbook or type: recipe.
research/ bundle is reserved for authored, evergreen agent-design research, prompt templates, and reusable design references (type: research-note or type: research-prompt).
Placing a type: research-note inside the operational memory_extractor recipe sub-bundle dilutes the thematic coherence of the recipes plane. Relocating it to research/ keeps the knowledge plane scannable and logically segmented for both humans and agents.

Section 2 — Specific Feedback & Edits
1. Feedback on 05_calibration_thresholds.md (The Research Note)
Tag Normalization: The tag list contains recipe (which contradicts its actual research-note type) and memory_extractor (using an underscore). The rest of the workspace and the parent bundle prefer hyphenated tags (memory-extractor) and thematic tags (research).
Broken Sibling Links: If the note is relocated to research/, sibling links like [03_enable_policy.md](03_enable_policy.md) will break and trigger linter warnings. They must be rewritten with relative hops to point back to the docs/recipes/memory_extractor/ folder.
